# function: mirek_from_kelvin

Returns 1,000,000 divided by the color temperature in kelvin, rounded to the nearest integer. The result must be within the API range of 50 to 1000 mirek, about 1000 K to 20000 K. Individual lights may support a narrower range. Requires Terraform 1.8 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hue_scene" "evening" {
  name  = "Evening"
  group = hue_zone.desk.id
  actions = {
    (data.hue_light.desk.id) = {
      on         = true
      brightness = 40
      mirek      = provider::hue::mirek_from_kelvin(2700) # 370
    }
  }
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
mirek_from_kelvin(kelvin number) number
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `kelvin` (Number) Color temperature in kelvin.
